correctness.rationale: The disjointness Galois equivalence yields alpha beta alpha=alpha and beta alpha beta=beta, so the NOR map F satisfies F^3=F for every state, and the recurrent image contains r^2 states with exactly r fixed and binomial(r,2) two-cycles. Direct one-step fiber products give every attraction basin. For the three explicitly checked valid 9_3 triple systems, independent algorithms computed all 512 shore subsets and also all 262,144 direct graph states separately, confirming r=110,112,113, fixed attraction 914,912,911, complete basin histograms, graph invariants, and sharp transient one. The cited combinatorial classification identifies all three types. All integer counts are finite, not infinite extrapolations.
